Customer Success and Case Notes Summary

Overall Status
- Seller-reported Deal Pulse is generally positive, with multiple Green pulse updates during FY2026 Q3 and Q4.
- Cisco teams remain actively engaged across security, cloud, networking, and collaboration programs.
- The customer is progressing on several strategic security initiatives, though adoption and operational challenges are still active.

Key Active Initiatives
- Multicloud Defense gateway enablement and FTDv conversion
- Secure Access / Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) testing
- XDR onboarding and Splunk integration planning
- Firewall upgrades and implementation support
- Webex collaboration improvements
- Intersight operational adoption
- Duo Advantage adoption
- Umbrella DNS deployment
- Secure Email ESA migration and upgrades

Recent Activity Highlights

| Date | Update |
|---|---|
| 2026-06-22 | Multicloud Defense ingress/egress gateways enabled; FTDv conversion in progress; Palo Alto competitive comparison completed; Azure flow testing completed |

| 2026-06-12 | Secure Access tenant provisioned; ZTNA testing started |
| 2026-05-21 | Customer reported satisfaction with firewall performance; Cisco actively engaged in implementation efforts |
| 2026-04-30 | XDR and Splunk integration discussions resumed after previous account hold was lifted; renewal concern for 2027 identified |

Key Risks and Concerns

Security / Renewal Risks
- Customer continues to use CrowdStrike for endpoint protection, reducing Secure Endpoint adoption potential.
- Multiple notes indicate potential renewal risk in 2027 tied to proving value and increasing adoption of Cisco security platforms.
- XDR telemetry correlation remains limited because integrations are incomplete.

Technical and Infrastructure Challenges
- SNA deployment is still locked on version 7.5.0; upgrade to 7.5.2 is required for full XDR functionality.
- Hardware lifecycle limitations are slowing broader deployment efforts.
- Firewall clustering constraints exist due to WCCP limitations.

Operational Issues
- Previous TAC dissatisfaction led to temporary account hold requests.
- VPN connectivity problems on FTD4215 headends affected roughly 8,000 remote users.
- Catalyst Center upgrades have been delayed because of customer concerns regarding software defects and platform stability.

Adoption Gaps
- Duo Premier capabilities are not fully utilized.
- Secure Workload segmentation initiative is paused pending leadership alignment.
- Umbrella deployment remains mostly limited to remote-user DNS use cases.

Cisco Actions and Support Delivered
- XDR onboarding completed successfully.
- Firewall assessments and technical consulting completed.
- Firewall HA pair upgraded to version 7.2.9.
- Weekly collaboration and customer success meetings requested.
- Technical adoption plans established.
- Customer de-risk strategy executed across multiple programs.
- UZTNA workshops and Secure Access overview sessions initiated.
- TAC cases opened for PSIRT automation connector failures.
- VPN workaround implementations completed.
- Umbrella health checks and logging support delivered.
- DNAC upgrade planning and bug scrub reviews completed.

Escalations and Remaining Blockers
- Prior account hold requests were linked to TAC dissatisfaction and ownership alignment issues involving XDR/Splunk.
- Current blockers include:
  - Infrastructure readiness gaps
  - Product bug dependencies
  - Migration and upgrade support needs
  - Limited operational readiness for seeded technologies
  - Need for additional adoption guidance
- Open TAC-related issue still exists around PSIRT automation connector failures.

| Off Trajectory | Duo Signature Adoption Premier, XDR value realization and adoption planning |
